purpose: Evaluate the current project state after forward BTC book recording and move the A+ path to the next validated data milestone.

strengths: Strategy search and registry gates are fail-closed.
Historical PMXT replay and strict-tail validation infrastructure already exists.
Forward BTC up/down books can now be recorded read-only from exact Gamma slugs.
Recorded forward books can now be converted into the existing distilled replay-cache format.
Converted forward captures can now be refreshed with terminal Gamma outcomes after close.
a_plus_blockers: No local BTC reference tape is present in the repo for the fresh forward captures.
Forward sample size is still tiny: one smoke capture with three resolved 5m markets is proof of plumbing, not strategy evidence.
A+ still requires repeated feed-forward replay/live-replay sessions with oracle agreement, causality checks, enough resolved samples, and strict tail gates.
project_evaluation.verdict: The project is technically closer to A+ because the fresh-data bottleneck is now a forward data pipeline rather than a PMXT remap mystery. It is not promotion-ready.

pmxt_remap_result.decision: Do not force-remap PMXT for fresh btc-updown-5m replay. Use forward exact-slug collection.

new_change.role_in_a_plus_path: Attach terminal Gamma outcomes to forward distilled captures so replay/evaluation can distinguish pending data from resolved ground truth.
safety: fail-closed terminal detection: markets without exactly one 1.0 outcome remain pending

next_a_plus_step.name: BTC tape attachment and feed-forward scoring
next_a_plus_step.why_next: Orderbook events and terminal Gamma outcomes are now available. The remaining missing ground-truth input is a BTC reference tape aligned to each 5m market open/close, followed by repeated resolved replay sessions.
minimum_success_criteria: BTC tape covers every forward market open_ts and close_ts.
A forward session/eval artifact contains signal/evaluation rows plus resolution rows for each resolved market.
Strategy-builder A+ replay checks see enough resolved/shadow samples, zero actionable oracle disagreements, and clean causality.
Strict loss-burst/CVaR gates remain fail-closed until enough repeated resolved samples exist.
